Which notebook entry best distinguishes Baseline and time horizon from Distribution and incidence?

generalfeedback.text: The decisive rule is Baseline and time horizon: A budget comparison depends on current-law assumptions, inflation, population, economic conditions, and the years included. Apply it to the named actor and facts, then test the relevant procedure or limit. The distractors either use the wrong policy principle, skip required reasoning, or claim power is unlimited.

MLA Standard: MLA.USG.PCY.4

A classmate says, “Accountability means the government can always obtain its preferred result.” What is the strongest correction?
